checksScope: These checks ran against the full private agent/payment runtimes. Log names identify retained private operational evidence, not files in this source mirror.

initialRun.failure: Fixture expected lane-level reason for invalid global config; global gate correctly refused it.

findings.disposition: Fixed: after the original 800-second window an explicitly inactive uncertain prepaid delivery fails the agent review while retaining its full payment hold. No replay or approval.
Fixed: fresh dispatch requires explicit surplus_credit admission; existing request IDs retain their original rail.
Fixed: all known workAdmission refusals carry the original ID and unsigned deferred marker. Only the exact rolled-back one-active SQL constraint can defer a reservation exception.
Fixed: readiness checks the configured 2-USDC ceiling; native quote input and output are never reduced.
Fixed: higher admission ceiling is restricted to at most two explicit project IDs and one exact UTC day. Counts are never reset.
Fixed: current source docs distinguish the historical verified deployment from the candidate. Final publication writes verified deployed hashes after exact source readback.
Fixed: operations documents the optional dated maximumGlobalDay allocation and the shared global counter.
Fixed: only canonical decimal strings 8 through 16 are accepted.
Fixed: waiting responses include workCandidate when reporting the intended payment rail.
Fixed: every workAdmission pre-reservation refusal emits exact-ID not_signed/deferred; the agent allowlist covers every current refusal reason.
Fixed: catch only SQLSTATE23505 on claus_credit_work_one_active. Its atomic statement rolls back; payment-ID collisions and ambiguous acknowledgements remain uncertain.
Documented: shared global ceilings are not reserved per-project allowances.
Accepted conservative accounting: unresolved dispatched holds remain within the finite aggregate ceiling. No automatic replenishment or release.
Existing network controller polls review status. Direct users must poll status; no separate scheduler or unconditional timeout release is introduced.
Bounded to the verified production ISO DateStyle; three actual timestamps parse. Evidence credit-timestamp-observation.json. Changing the database DateStyle is outside the operation.

The mirrors are review context, not standalone runnable agent/payment packages. Real private-source targeted tests, typecheck, complete source manifests and deployment verification are retained; no full-service audit is claimed.

finalFindings.title: Introduced: agent hard-codes a 16384 output cap that an unpatched payer refuses; the ordering dependency is undocumented and each mis-ordered review fails terminally for its input hash
finalFindings.disposition: Addressed in the deployment procedure: promote and verify the widened payment relay first; the agent promotion checks the exact live payment deployment/source. Rollback must restore the older agent before reverting the payment validator. No capability auto-fallback or smaller review is introduced.

finalFindings.title: Unchanged mechanism, exposure widened: credit-lane telemetry reports effectiveMaxOutputTokens from the sent request and ignores the provider's x-si-adapted-params header
finalFindings.disposition: Accepted telemetry limitation: effectiveMaxOutputTokens records the request sent, not proof of the provider internal cap. Completion and actual usage will be recorded from the genuine first calls; public documentation must not claim provider-adaptation verification.

finalFindings.title: Unchanged limitation: the 600 s provider deadline is not widened with the 4x larger reasoning budget; a time-cut review still ends failed with its 2 USDC hold retained
finalFindings.disposition: Accepted existing finite deadline and retained-uncertainty accounting. No timeout replay or hold release. Actual completion latency remains a live acceptance criterion.

finalFindings.title: Unchanged limitation: the 2 USDC ceiling with no quote shrinking now applies to a 16384-token quote, narrowing the affordable input range by roughly 58261 microUSDC
finalFindings.disposition: Accepted intended clean refusal under the unchanged 2-USDC maximum, with no shrinking, refill or disguised free allocation.

finalFindings.title: Unchanged trust assumption, widened: the 16384 lane is selected by the caller-chosen Idempotency-Key pattern alone, so any INFERENCE_SECRET holder can obtain the widened budget
finalFindings.disposition: Accepted trusted internal-secret boundary. This endpoint is not public inference; preserve the secret, finite per-call/lifetime limits and strict review-ID routing.

limitations: Actual model decision, finalized contract execution and normal scheduled run remain required.
No old hold or original request is released or replayed.
No public inference, customer custody, token launch or unbounded financial grant.

priorCreditFinalFindings.disposition: Accepted existing fail-closed boundary for provider or operator configuration changes between snapshots. No new payment or hold is created. Uniform retries outside the reviewed admission path are not claimed.
Final publication removes the dangling public log pointer and labels full private-runtime checks explicitly, with a link to the deployment/check evidence. Runtime unchanged.
Accepted existing boundary: a fenced ID may wait while another slot is occupied, but cannot reserve or pay when capacity returns. The agent never resubmits a terminally fenced review.
